page.overview:
Who is Radovid I?

Radovid I, also known as "the Great", was the king of Redania and the brother of Prince Troyden. He had a number of sons, of whom only Dambor did not tragically die before 30.

His reign has been much lauded for making great strides for the kingdom, and Radovid's actions in life have been held up as the ideal model for many a ruler.
